div.div:
طَهَا is used by Abu-n-Nejm for طٰهٰ meaning the Chapter of the Kur-án [thus called, because commencing with these two letters, namely, the 20th,] in his saying, “مَدَّ لَنَا فِى عُمْرِهِ رَبُّ طَهَا
” [May the Lord of طٰهٰ lengthen for us his life]. (TA.) [See art. طه.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
